heading: **6 November 2025**
body:
***1\. PNK treatment of lig147***

5X

| DNA | 1000 ng |
| :---- | :---- |
| T4 PNK Buffer | 5 uL |
| 10 mM ATP | 5 uL |
| T4 PNK | 1 uL |

Incubate on PNK program. Pool products and purify with MinElute columns.

***2\. PCR1 repeat for ligN40w100***

Prepare a 100X reaction mix:

| Reagent | Volume (µL) |
| ----- | ----- |
| **ligN40w107 Ann** | **200** |
| **Phusion Master Mix** | **2500** |
| **NCAP\_F (10 µM)** | **250** |
| **NCAP\_R (10 uM)** | **250** |
| **Water** | **1800**  |
| **Total** | **5000** |

Split mix into 25 uL per well for two 96-well PCR plates.

| 98°C | 3 min |
| :---- | :---- |
| 98°C | 10 s |
| 55°C | 15 s       **6X\*** |
| 72°C | 30 s |
| 72°C | 40 min |
| 4°C | HOLD |

The PCR product was pooled and 30 uL of the sample was run on a gel.

Concentration of PCR1 \= 16.1 ng/uL

Set up PCR2 with \~20-24 ng per reaction:

Prepare a 100X reaction mix:

| Reagent | Volume (µL) |
| ----- | ----- |
| **ligN40w107 Ann** | **150** |
| **Phusion Master Mix** | **2500** |
| **NCAP\_F (10 µM)** | **250** |
| **NCAP\_R (10 uM)** | **250** |
| **Water** | **1850**  |
| **Total** | **5000** |

Split mix into 50 uL per well for two 96-well PCR plates.

| 98°C | 3 min |
| :---- | :---- |
| 98°C | 10 s |
| 55°C | 15 s       **2X\*** |
| 72°C | 30 s |
| 72°C | 40 min |
| 4°C | HOLD |

***3\. DpnI & MboI testing (D7 & D8 samples)***

Samples processed : lig20K, L11, D7-UB(h), D7’(h), D7-UB(ph), D8

lig20K: \~10 ng

L11: \~10 ng

D7-UB(h): 1.91 uL

D7’(h): 8.8 uL (1.23 ng)

D7-UB(ph): 5.8 uL 

D8: 7.1 uL

| DNA | 10 ng |
| :---- | :---- |
| rCutsmart Buffer | 1 uL |
| DpnI/MboI | 0.2 uL |
| Total  | 10 uL |

*Dpn*I

| 37 C | 1 hour |
| :---- | :---- |
| 80 C | 20 mins |

*Mbo*I

| 37 C | 1 hour |
| :---- | :---- |
| 65 C | 20 mins |

***4\. SELEX checklist***

| Requirement | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| lig147 plate (2x) | **Prepared** |
| ligN40w107 plate (2x) | In Preparation |
| PCR Mix Plate (non-PE PCR) (18x) | To be prepared  |
| qPCR Mix Plate (18x) | To be prepared |
| Forward Primer Plate 5 uM (PE PCR)  | **Prepared** |
| Reverse Primer Plate 5 uM (PE PCR) | **PE0-PE3 prepared\*** |
| Dilution Buffer Plate (for reconstitution) | Buffer Prepared |
| Biotin Elution Buffer Plate | To be prepared |
| SBP Beads Plate | To be prepared |
| Ni Beads Plate | To be prepared |
| Diluted TF Plate | Prepared 2 days prior to assay |
| Buffers | In Preparation |
| Dried Salt Plates | **Prepared** |
| SBP Histone Octamer Plate | Prepared just prior to assay for octamer stability |
| Beckman Programs | Programs Added Pipetting template to be tested |

***5\. Transformation of new batch of GenScript plasmids to Rosetta cells (15 plasmids)***

Each vial of the Rosetta cells is 0.2 mL ⇒ Aliquot into 20 uL each and transform by adding 0.3 uL of each plasmid.

Each plasmid is resuspended in 100 uL of NF water i.e. concentration \= \~40 ng/uL

***5\. L11 ligation repeat***

| lig147-PNK (1000 ng) | 3.88 uL |
| :---- | :---- |
| 50% PEG8000 | 3 uL |
| CoHex 10 mM | 1 uL |
| T4 Ligase Buffer 10X | 1 uL |
| T4 DNA ligase | 1.22 uL |

Incubate these tubes O/N at RT.
